blocks.html: The data to create a shipping method for a return.

types.name: CreateReturnShippingMethodWorkflowInput
types.description: The data to create a shipping method for a return.

children.name: return_id
children.description: The ID of the return to create the shipping method for.

children.name: claim_id
children.description: The ID of the claim associated with the return, if any.

children.name: exchange_id
children.description: The ID of the exchange associated with the return, if any.

children.name: shipping_option_id
children.description: The ID of the shipping option to create the shipping method from.

children.name: custom_amount
children.description:
The custom amount to charge for the shipping method.
If not provided, the amount from the shipping option will be used.
